evals.name: character-unreadable-in-shade
evals.prompt: Third-person game in Godot 4.7. Since I improved the lighting (real shadows, fog), my player character basically disappears when walking through shaded streets. I don't want to brighten the whole level or the walls around him. Write player_fill_light.gd that I can attach to my Player (CharacterBody3D with a MeshInstance3D child) to fix it.
evals.expected_output: Script adds a small low-energy OmniLight3D following the player, no shadows, restricted with light_cull_mask to a dedicated render layer that is added to the player's VisualInstance3D layers (keeping layer 1). Compiles in Godot 4.7.

evals.name: vignette-grain-aa-finish
evals.prompt: Final polish pass on my godot 4.7 3D game: I want a subtle vignette, some film grain, and the roof edges are jagged + the foliage shimmers when the camera moves. Give me the files and tell me where to put them. Keep it subtle.
evals.expected_output: A canvas_item post shader (CanvasLayer + full-rect ColorRect, hint_screen_texture) for vignette + animated grain (no non-existent Environment vignette property), anti-aliasing via MSAA (2x) + TAA or screen-space AA on the viewport/project settings, setup instructions, subtle defaults. Compiles in Godot 4.7.
